SELECT f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS after_rise, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, f.channel_code, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_ids, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS gross, SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat, SUM(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate) AS vat_calc
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period=5 AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_ids, MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date), COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, MIN(etl_loaded_at), MAX(etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period=5 AND s.store_id<900

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id<900
 GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales_before_returns AS rnet FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND store_id<900)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_cmp, SUM(l.net) AS lines_net, SUM(r.rnet) AS rpt_net, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(COALESCE(l.net,0)-COALESCE(r.rnet,0))>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatches
FROM l FULL JOIN r ON l.sale_date=r.business_date AND l.store_id=r.store_id

SELECT 'excluded' AS kind, s.store_id=999 AS is999, p.category='ZZ Test' AS is_test, f.vat_rate, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) AS vat
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test') GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', NULL, NULL, r.vat_rate, COUNT(*), SUM(r.refund_gross-r.refund_net)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1,4

calls.statement:
SELECT 'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(f.vat_rate*100, 1) AS vat_rate_pct,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales, SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY f.vat_rate ORDER BY f.vat_rate
